readme_roadmap.title: Complete cinematic playback
readme_roadmap.detail: 545 sources / 16 worlds; zero complete scenes verified. Whole-corpus CPU inventory completed: 61 sources report implementation/preparation gaps, zero top-level preparation failures. Largest shared cause: FX actor-mutation prefixes in 52 sources; general FX queue limits in six, partial FX services in 15 (overlapping counts). The separate 282-source strict-profile review queue is not a count of broken scenes. Published preview 2026.11.05.5 retains four targeted natural-ending/re-entry controls, including the 54-director Story4 chain twice. The older .4 menu matrix stopped after 24/29 completed passes. All-source visual/audio/subtitle fidelity, native cadence, complete effects, skipping and continuity remain open.
